Question: A trapezoid has side lengths \(3,\) \(5,\) \(7,\) and \(11.\) The sum of all the possible areas of the trapezoid can be written in the form of \(r_1\sqrt{n_1} + r_2\sqrt{n_2} + r_3,\) where \(r_1,\) \(r_2,\) and \(r_3\) are rational numbers and \(n_1\) and \(n_2\) are positive integers not divisible by the square of a prime. What is the greatest integer less than or equal to \[r_1 + r_2 + r_3 + n_1 + n_2?\]
